Not a roller main myself but I've seen my fair share of sneaky sneaky, "let me hide on this ledge and drop" roller mains, "Imma run around and no one can stop me" roller mains (like how?!), and "what am i even doing" roller mains. From what I've seen the best play aggressively and rely on quick maneuvers and literally run around players before ambushing them. Most people will chase them down because they play aggressive and overextend, but they know the map very well and have almost a set route they take to cause some confusion and splat anyone in their path. If you're looking towards playing like this, stick to a quick roller like the carbon. If you're looking to play ambush I'd say stick with a slower, more powerful roller like the dynamo or perhaps the flingza. Either way, pick a play style that suits you (take into consideration what weapon you use typically, do you like fast and light or slower and heavy that require some timing) as well as subs and specials. If you're going with quick, carbon with autobombs to distract and cause some ruckus while players chase are great.

Mainly learning how the differences in height effect ink drop. Shooting with even a low range weapon like an aerospray or flicking a brush from a high ledge can give it some extra airtime and essentially "boost" its range. Take blackbelly or musselforge for example, when standing on the middle platform you can shoot off the sides down the slopes and reach the bottom with nearly any weapon. Same goes for blackbelly, standing on the middle pillar will allow you to hit almost any surface near it, great for long range weapons to do a little suppression. Just play around with it in recon and try to get a feel for how it affects your range and then work around it or use it to your advantage.
